newsitem.title: USA: Centerior Perry power plant trips off line.
newsitem.headline: Centerior Perry power plant trips off line.

text.p: Centerior Energy Corp's 1,205 megawatt (MW) Perry nuclear power plant, in North Perry, Ohio, tripped off line due to an internal power failure, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Wednesday.
The NRC, in its daily status report, said the unit went off line Tuesday following a power failure in its inverter, causing the reactor to "scram," or automatically shut down.
The unit is currently producing no power and no restart estimate was given by the NRC.
It was producing at 100 percent earlier in the day.
The unit is being kept in hot shutdown mode, which typically indicates a prompt restart is expected.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
